fr.R: À cause de cela, Dieu l’a considéré comme juste pour toujours.

sw.L: Na hilo likahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki, kizazi hata kizazi, milele.
sw.B: Na tendo hilo likahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki kwa vizazi vyote, hata milele.
sw.R: Kwa sababu hiyo, Mungu alimhesabu kuwa mwenye haki kwa nyakati zote zijazo.

es.L: Y le fue contado por justicia, de generación en generación, para siempre.
es.B: Y ese hecho le fue contado como justicia por todas las generaciones, para siempre.
es.R: Por eso, Dios lo consideró justo para siempre.

vi.L: Và điều ấy được kể cho ông là công chính, cho thế hệ này và thế hệ kia, đến đời đời.
vi.B: Và việc ấy được kể cho ông là công chính qua mọi thế hệ, cho đến mãi mãi.
vi.R: Vì việc này, Đức Chúa Trời kể ông là người công chính cho đến mãi mãi về sau.

decisions.reason: The words recall Abraham, whose faith the LORD "counted to him as righteousness" (Genesis 15:6). Phinehas was given a covenant of lasting priesthood (Numbers 25:11-13).

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: for all time
decisions.reason: The doubled word means every generation to come.
Readable names who counted it.

source.text: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they provoked [him] at [the] waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses on account of them,

en.L: And they made [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] angry at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses because of them,
en.B: At the waters of Meribah they made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry, and Moses paid dearly because of them,
en.R: At the springs of Meribah they made God angry, and Moses got into trouble because of them.

fr.L: Et ils [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]ont irrité aux eaux de Meriba, et il en est allé mal pour Moïse à cause d’eux,
fr.B: Aux eaux de Meriba, ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont mis en colère, et Moïse a payé cher à cause d’eux,
fr.R: Aux sources de Meriba, ils ont mis Dieu en colère, et Moïse a eu des ennuis à cause d’eux.

sw.L: Wakamkasirisha kwenye maji ya Meriba, ikawa vibaya kwa Musa kwa sababu yao,
sw.B: Kwenye maji ya Meriba walimkasirisha, naye Musa akapata hasara kubwa kwa sababu yao,
sw.R: Kwenye chemchemi za Meriba walimkasirisha Mungu, naye Musa akapata taabu kwa sababu yao.

es.L: Y [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] irritaron junto a las aguas de Meribá, y le fue mal a Moisés por causa de ellos,
es.B: Junto a las aguas de Meribá {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hicieron enojar, y Moisés pagó caro por culpa de ellos,
es.R: En los manantiales de Meribá hicieron enojar a Dios, y Moisés se metió en problemas por culpa de ellos.

vi.L: Và họ đã làm [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] nổi giận tại nước Mê-ri-ba, và Môi-se gặp điều chẳng lành vì cớ họ,
vi.B: Tại nước Mê-ri-ba họ làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận, và Môi-se phải chịu thiệt nặng vì họ,
vi.R: Tại suối nước Mê-ri-ba, họ làm Đức Chúa Trời nổi giận, và Môi-se gặp rắc rối vì họ.

decisions.reason: At Kadesh the people quarreled with Moses for water; Moses struck the rock, and God told him he would not lead the people into the land (Numbers 20:2-13; Deuteronomy 1:37; 3:26).
The verb has no object; God is meant, as in verse 29, though Moses too was provoked.
The name means quarreling or dispute (95:8).
Readable names whom they angered (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: for they rebelled against his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.

en.L: for they rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
en.B: for they defied {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, and Moses let hasty words pass his lips.
en.R: They rebelled against God's Spirit, and Moses said things he should not have said.

fr.L: car ils se sont rebellés contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit, et il a parlé à la légère de ses lèvres.
fr.B: car ils ont défié {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit, et Moïse a laissé sortir de ses lèvres des paroles irréfléchies.
fr.R: Ils se sont révoltés contre l’Esprit de Dieu, et Moïse a dit des choses qu’il n’aurait pas dû dire.

sw.L: kwa maana waliasi dhidi ya Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, naye akasema kwa haraka kwa midomo yake.
sw.B: kwa kuwa walimpinga Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na Musa akatamka maneno ya haraka kwa midomo yake.
sw.R: Waliasi dhidi ya Roho wa Mungu, na Musa akasema mambo ambayo hakupaswa kusema.

es.L: porque se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, y él habló sin pensar con sus labios.
es.B: porque desafiaron a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, y Moisés dejó salir de sus labios palabras precipitadas.
es.R: Se rebelaron contra el Espíritu de Dios, y Moisés dijo cosas que no debía haber dicho.

vi.L: vì họ đã chống nghịch Thần của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và ông đã nói cách hấp tấp bằng môi miệng mình.
vi.B: vì họ chống lại Thần của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và Môi-se đã để những lời hấp tấp thốt ra từ môi miệng.
vi.R: Họ đã chống lại Thần của Đức Chúa Trời, và Môi-se đã nói những điều ông không nên nói.

decisions.reason: The verb (himrah) is the word for rebelling against God used in verses 7 and 43, and Isaiah 63 speaks of Israel rebelling against God's Holy Spirit in the wilderness. Others take "his spirit" as Moses' spirit, which the people made bitter.
Moses said, "Listen, you rebels; must we bring water for you out of this rock?" and struck it (Numbers 20:10-12).
Balanced and Readable name who spoke rashly, since "his" has just meant God.
Readable names whose Spirit, as taken in m1.

The meaning decision reads this as God's own Spirit, as the English capital does; "Thần" is the usual Vietnamese Old Testament word for God's Spirit, while "Đức Thánh Linh" would bring in the New Testament's title.

source.text: לֹֽא־הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They did not destroy the peoples which YHWH said to them,

en.L: They did not destroy the peoples, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to them,
en.B: They did not wipe out the peoples {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told them to destroy,
en.R: When they entered the land, they did not destroy the nations there, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded.

fr.L: Ils n’ont pas détruit les peuples, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le leur avait dit,
fr.B: Ils n’ont pas anéanti les peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur avait dit de détruire,
fr.R: Quand ils sont entrés dans le pays, ils n’ont pas détruit les nations qui s’y trouvaient, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné.

sw.L: Hawakuwaangamiza watu wa mataifa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyowaambia,
sw.B: Hawakuyafutilia mbali mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewaagiza wayaangamize,
sw.R: Walipoingia katika nchi, hawakuyaangamiza mataifa yaliyokuwa huko, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru.

es.L: No destruyeron a los pueblos, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había dicho,
es.B: No acabaron con los pueblos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había mandado destruir,
es.R: Cuando entraron en la tierra, no destruyeron a las naciones que vivían allí, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había ordenado.

vi.L: Họ đã không tiêu diệt các dân, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với họ,
vi.B: Họ không tiêu diệt các dân mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho họ phải diệt,
vi.R: Khi vào xứ, họ không tiêu diệt các dân tộc ở đó, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền lệnh.

decisions.choice: the peoples left in the land
decisions.reason: The tribes did not drive out the peoples of Canaan (Judges 1:21-36), and the LORD's messenger rebuked them at Bochim (Judges 2:1-3).

decisions.choice: the command to destroy the peoples
decisions.reason: The law commanded Israel to destroy the peoples of Canaan so that Israel would not learn to worship their gods (Deuteronomy 7:1-5; 20:18). The psalm does not soften the command; it shows what came of ignoring it (verses 35-39).
Readable marks the move from the wilderness to Canaan.

source.text: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and they mixed themselves with the nations and learned their deeds,

en.L: and they mingled with the nations and learned their deeds,
en.B: instead they mixed with the nations and took up their ways.
en.R: Instead, they mixed with those nations and learned to live like them.

fr.L: et ils se sont mêlés aux nations et ont appris leurs pratiques,
fr.B: au contraire, ils se sont mêlés aux nations et ont adopté leurs façons de faire.
fr.R: Au contraire, ils se sont mêlés à ces nations et ont appris à vivre comme elles.

sw.L: nao wakachanganyika na mataifa, wakajifunza matendo yao,
sw.B: badala yake walichanganyika na mataifa, wakazifuata desturi zao.
sw.R: Badala yake, walichanganyika na mataifa hayo, wakajifunza kuishi kama wao.

es.L: y se mezclaron con las naciones y aprendieron sus obras,
es.B: sino que se mezclaron con las naciones y adoptaron sus costumbres.
es.R: Al contrario, se mezclaron con esas naciones y aprendieron a vivir como ellas.

vi.L: và họ đã pha trộn với các dân tộc và học theo những việc làm của chúng,
vi.B: trái lại, họ hòa lẫn với các dân tộc và tập theo lối sống của chúng.
vi.R: Trái lại, họ hòa lẫn với các dân tộc ấy và học sống giống như họ.

decisions.reason: Israel lived among the peoples of Canaan, married their daughters and served their gods (Judges 3:5-6).
The verb (hit'arev) is to mix oneself in, to join a people, including by marriage (Ezra 9:2).

source.text: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: and they served their idols, and they became for them a snare.

en.L: and they served their idols, and they became a snare to them.
en.B: They served those nations' idols, which turned into a trap for them.
en.R: They worshiped the idols of those nations, and those idols trapped them.

fr.L: et ils ont servi leurs idoles, et elles sont devenues pour eux un piège.
fr.B: Ils ont servi les idoles de ces nations, qui sont devenues un piège pour eux.
fr.R: Ils ont adoré les idoles de ces nations, et ces idoles les ont pris au piège.

sw.L: wakazitumikia sanamu zao, nazo zikawa mtego kwao.
sw.B: Walizitumikia sanamu za mataifa hayo, nazo zikawa mtego kwao.
sw.R: Waliziabudu sanamu za mataifa hayo, nazo sanamu hizo zikawanasa.

es.L: y sirvieron a sus ídolos, que llegaron a ser para ellos una trampa.
es.B: Sirvieron a los ídolos de esas naciones, que se convirtieron en una trampa para ellos.
es.R: Adoraron a los ídolos de esas naciones, y esos ídolos los atraparon.

vi.L: và họ đã phục vụ các thần tượng của chúng, và chúng đã trở thành cái bẫy cho họ.
vi.B: Họ thờ phụng các thần tượng của những dân ấy, và những thần tượng ấy trở thành cạm bẫy cho họ.
vi.R: Họ thờ lạy các thần tượng của những dân tộc đó, và những thần tượng ấy đã bẫy họ.

decisions.reason: The law warned that the gods of the peoples would be a snare to Israel (Deuteronomy 7:16), and so it was (Judges 2:3, 11-13).

decisions.choice: a snare: a trap that catches
decisions.reason: A snare is a bird trap; the idols drew Israel in and held them.
Balanced and Readable make clear whose idols they were.

source.text: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons.

en.L: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
en.B: They even offered up their own sons and daughters to demons.
en.R: They even killed their own sons and daughters as sacrifices to demons.

fr.L: Et ils ont sacrifié leurs fils et leurs filles aux démons.
fr.B: Ils ont même offert leurs propres fils et leurs propres filles aux démons.
fr.R: Ils ont même tué leurs propres fils et leurs propres filles pour les offrir en sacrifice aux démons.

sw.L: Wakawatoa dhabihu wana wao na binti zao kwa mashetani.
sw.B: Waliwatoa hata wana wao na binti zao wenyewe kuwa sadaka kwa mashetani.
sw.R: Waliwaua hata wana wao na binti zao wenyewe kuwa dhabihu kwa mashetani.

es.L: Y sacrificaron a sus hijos y a sus hijas a los demonios.
es.B: Hasta ofrecieron a sus propios hijos e hijas a los demonios.
es.R: Hasta mataron a sus propios hijos e hijas como sacrificio a los demonios.

vi.L: Và họ đã tế con trai và con gái mình cho các quỷ.
vi.B: Họ còn dâng chính con trai con gái mình làm của tế lễ cho các quỷ.
vi.R: Họ còn giết chính con trai con gái của mình để cúng tế cho các quỷ.

decisions.choice: demons: the powers behind the idols
decisions.reason: The word (shedim) is used only here and in Deuteronomy 32:17, where Israel sacrificed "to demons, not to God". The idols of verse 36 stand for spiritual powers that are not God.
The law forbade giving children to Molech (Leviticus 18:21), and the prophets condemned the burning of children in the valley of Hinnom (Jeremiah 7:31; 19:5).
Balanced and Readable mark this as the depth of Israel's sin.

source.text: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they shed innocent blood, [the] blood of their sons and their daughters whom they sacrificed to [the] idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with the blood[shed].

en.L: And they shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
en.B: They spilled the blood of the innocent, their own sons and daughters, slaughtered as offerings to Canaan's idols, and the land was made unclean by bloodshed.
en.R: They killed innocent children, their own sons and daughters, as sacrifices to the idols of Canaan. Their blood made the land unclean.

fr.L: Et ils ont versé le sang innocent, le sang de leurs fils et de leurs filles, qu’ils ont sacrifiés aux idoles de Canaan, et le pays a été profané par le sang.
fr.B: Ils ont répandu le sang des innocents, de leurs propres fils et filles, égorgés en offrande aux idoles de Canaan, et le pays a été rendu impur par le sang versé.
fr.R: Ils ont tué des enfants innocents, leurs propres fils et filles, pour les offrir aux idoles de Canaan. Leur sang a rendu le pays impur.

sw.L: Wakamwaga damu isiyo na hatia, damu ya wana wao na binti zao, waliowatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani, na nchi ikatiwa unajisi kwa damu.
sw.B: Walimwaga damu ya wasio na hatia, wana wao na binti zao wenyewe, waliochinjwa kuwa sadaka kwa sanamu za Kanaani, na nchi ikanajisiwa kwa umwagaji wa damu.
sw.R: Waliwaua watoto wasio na hatia, wana wao na binti zao wenyewe, kuwa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani. Damu yao iliifanya nchi kuwa najisi.

es.L: Y derramaron sangre inocente, la sangre de sus hijos y de sus hijas, que sacrificaron a los ídolos de Canaán, y la tierra fue profanada con sangre.
es.B: Derramaron la sangre de inocentes, de sus propios hijos e hijas, degollados como ofrendas a los ídolos de Canaán, y la tierra quedó impura por la sangre derramada.
es.R: Mataron a niños inocentes, sus propios hijos e hijas, como sacrificio a los ídolos de Canaán. Su sangre hizo impura la tierra.

vi.L: Và họ đã đổ máu vô tội, máu của con trai và con gái họ, mà họ đã tế cho các thần tượng của Ca-na-an, và đất bị ô uế bởi máu.
vi.B: Họ đổ máu người vô tội, máu chính con trai con gái mình, bị giết làm của lễ cho các thần tượng Ca-na-an, và đất bị ô uế vì máu đổ ra.
vi.R: Họ giết những đứa trẻ vô tội, chính con trai con gái của mình, để cúng tế cho các thần tượng của Ca-na-an. Máu của chúng làm cho đất bị ô uế.

decisions.reason: The verb (chanaf) is used in Numbers 35:33: bloodshed pollutes the land, and only the blood of the killer can make atonement for it.
The plural of the word for blood means blood that has been shed, killing.
Shedding innocent blood is the sin named against Manasseh, for which Judah was sent into exile (Jeremiah 19:4; 2 Kings 24:4).

source.text: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they became unclean by their works, and they prostituted themselves by their deeds.

en.L: And they became unclean by their works, and played the prostitute by their deeds.
en.B: They made themselves unclean by what they did and were unfaithful like a prostitute in their ways.
en.R: What they did made them unclean. They were unfaithful to God, like a wife who sleeps with other men.

fr.L: Et ils se sont rendus impurs par leurs œuvres, et ils se sont prostitués par leurs actions.
fr.B: Ils se sont rendus impurs par ce qu’ils faisaient et ont été infidèles comme une prostituée dans leur conduite.
fr.R: Ce qu’ils faisaient les a rendus impurs. Ils ont été infidèles à Dieu, comme une femme qui couche avec d’autres hommes.

sw.L: Wakajitia unajisi kwa kazi zao, wakafanya ukahaba kwa matendo yao.
sw.B: Walijinajisi kwa yale waliyoyatenda, wakakosa uaminifu kama kahaba katika njia zao.
sw.R: Matendo yao yaliwafanya najisi. Hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu, kama mke anayelala na wanaume wengine.

es.L: Y se hicieron impuros con sus obras, y se prostituyeron con sus hechos.
es.B: Se hicieron impuros con lo que hacían y fueron infieles, como una prostituta, en su manera de vivir.
es.R: Lo que hacían los hizo impuros. Fueron infieles a Dios, como una esposa que se acuesta con otros hombres.

vi.L: Và họ đã trở nên ô uế bởi những việc làm của họ, và đã làm điều dâm loạn bởi những hành vi của họ.
vi.B: Họ tự làm mình ô uế bởi những việc họ làm và bất trung như kẻ làm điếm trong đường lối mình.
vi.R: Những việc họ làm khiến họ bị ô uế. Họ bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời, như người vợ ngủ với những người đàn ông khác.

decisions.choice: prostituted themselves: were unfaithful to God
decisions.reason: Worship of other gods is pictured as a wife's unfaithfulness, since Israel was bound to the LORD by covenant (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17).

decisions.choice: became unclean: unfit to come before God
decisions.reason: The verb (tame') is the word for ritual uncleanness; here it is caused by idolatry and bloodshed (Leviticus 18:24-25).

decisions.choice: unfaithful to God, like a wife who sleeps with other men
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] anger of YHWH burned against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.

en.L: And the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} abhorred {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned with anger against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and came to loathe {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became very angry with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He was disgusted with the people who belonged to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est enflammée contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a eu en horreur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est enflammé de colère contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pris en dégoût ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenait.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis très en colère contre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il était dégoûté du peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenait.

sw.L: Na hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akauchukia urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaka hasira juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akaanza kuchukizwa na watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakasirikia sana watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Alichukizwa na watu waliokuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: Y se encendió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aborreció {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad.
es.B: Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ardió de ira contra {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y llegó a sentir asco de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia posesión.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Sintió asco del pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecía.

vi.L: Và cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nổi phừng lên nghịch cùng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gớm ghét cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi cơn giận nghịch cùng dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đâm ra ghê tởm chính cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài ghê tởm chính dân thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: "The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and he gave them into the hands of plunderers" is the refrain of Judges (Judges 2:14, 20; 3:8; 10:7). Verses 40-46 sum up that whole period.
The verb (ti'ev) is used of what is detestable. God's own people had become hateful to him by their idols; yet verse 45 says he remembered his covenant.
As in verse 5, Israel is God's possession.

source.text: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gave them into [the] hand of nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them into the hand of nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
en.B: He handed them over to other nations, and people who hated them became their masters.
en.R: He let other nations take control of them. People who hated them ruled over them.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés aux mains des nations, et ceux qui les haïssaient ont dominé sur eux.
fr.B: Il les a livrés à d’autres nations, et des gens qui les haïssaient sont devenus leurs maîtres.
fr.R: Il a laissé d’autres nations prendre le pouvoir sur eux. Des gens qui les détestaient les ont gouvernés.

sw.L: Naye akawatia mkononi mwa mataifa, na wale waliowachukia wakawatawala.
sw.B: Aliwatia katika mikono ya mataifa mengine, na watu waliowachukia wakawa mabwana wao.
sw.R: Aliyaacha mataifa mengine yawatawale. Watu waliowachukia waliwatawala.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregó en mano de las naciones, y los que los odiaban se enseñorearon de ellos.
es.B: Los entregó a otras naciones, y la gente que los odiaba se hizo dueña de ellos.
es.R: Dejó que otras naciones los dominaran. Gente que los odiaba los gobernó.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phó họ vào tay các dân tộc, và những kẻ ghét họ đã cai trị họ.
vi.B: Ngài phó họ cho các dân tộc khác, và những kẻ ghét họ trở thành chủ của họ.
vi.R: Ngài để các dân tộc khác nắm quyền trên họ. Những kẻ ghét họ cai trị họ.

decisions.choice: given into the hand of nations
decisions.reason: God gave Israel into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim, Eglon of Moab, Jabin of Canaan, Midian and others (Judges 3:8, 12-14; 4:2; 6:1; 10:7).

decisions.choice: into the hand: into the power
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, the hand means power.

source.text: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.

en.L: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought low under their hand.
en.B: Their enemies crushed them and forced them to bow under their power.
en.R: Their enemies treated them cruelly and forced them to obey.

fr.L: Et leurs ennemis les ont opprimés, et ils ont été abaissés sous leur main.
fr.B: Leurs ennemis les ont écrasés et les ont forcés à se courber sous leur pouvoir.
fr.R: Leurs ennemis les ont traités avec cruauté et les ont obligés à obéir.

sw.L: Na adui zao wakawaonea, nao wakanyenyekezwa chini ya mkono wao.
sw.B: Adui zao waliwaponda na kuwalazimisha kuinama chini ya mamlaka yao.
sw.R: Adui zao waliwatendea ukatili na kuwalazimisha kuwatii.

es.L: Y sus enemigos los oprimieron, y fueron humillados bajo su mano.
es.B: Sus enemigos los aplastaron y los obligaron a doblegarse bajo su poder.
es.R: Sus enemigos los trataron con crueldad y los obligaron a obedecer.

vi.L: Và kẻ thù đã áp bức họ, và họ bị hạ thấp dưới tay chúng.
vi.B: Kẻ thù đè bẹp họ và bắt họ phải khuất phục dưới quyền lực chúng.
vi.R: Kẻ thù đối xử tàn nhẫn với họ và bắt họ phải vâng phục.

decisions.reason: Jabin oppressed Israel harshly for twenty years (Judges 4:3); the Ammonites crushed them for eighteen (Judges 10:8).
The verb (nikhna') is to be brought low, used of enemies subdued (Judges 3:30; 8:28).

source.text: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Many times he delivered them, but they rebelled in their counsel, and they sank low in their iniquity.

en.L: Many times {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivered them, but they rebelled in their counsel, and they sank low in their iniquity.
en.B: Again and again {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued them, but they kept to their own rebellious plans and sank down in their sin.
en.R: Time after time {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set them free, but they kept choosing to turn against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Their sins dragged them down.

fr.L: Bien des fois {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a délivrés, mais ils se sont rebellés dans leurs desseins, et ils se sont enfoncés dans leur faute.
fr.B: Encore et encore {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a délivrés, mais ils se sont obstinés dans leurs projets de révolte et se sont enfoncés dans leur péché.
fr.R: Bien des fois, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a libérés, mais ils choisissaient toujours de se tourner contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Leurs péchés les entraînaient vers le bas.

sw.L: Mara nyingi aliwaokoa, lakini wao waliasi katika shauri lao, wakadidimia katika uovu wao.
sw.B: Tena na tena aliwaokoa, lakini wao wakashikilia mipango yao ya uasi, wakazama katika dhambi yao.
sw.R: Mara kwa mara aliwaweka huru, lakini waliendelea kuchagua kumwasi. Dhambi zao ziliwavuta chini.

es.L: Muchas veces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los libró, pero ellos se rebelaron en su consejo, y se hundieron en su iniquidad.
es.B: Una y otra vez {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los rescató, pero ellos se aferraron a sus propios planes rebeldes y se hundieron en su pecado.
es.R: Una y otra vez {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los liberó, pero ellos seguían decidiendo volverse contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Sus pecados los arrastraron hacia abajo.

vi.L: Nhiều lần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu họ, nhưng họ đã nổi loạn trong mưu tính của họ, và họ đã chìm xuống trong sự gian ác của họ.
vi.B: Hết lần này đến lần khác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ, nhưng họ cứ bám lấy mưu tính phản nghịch của mình và chìm sâu trong tội lỗi.
vi.R: Biết bao lần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải thoát họ, nhưng họ cứ chọn quay lưng lại với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tội lỗi của họ kéo họ xuống.

decisions.choice: the judges and the people's relapses
decisions.reason: God raised up judges who saved Israel, but when each judge died the people turned back to worse ways (Judges 2:16-19).
The word ('etsah) is a plan; they followed their own counsel instead of waiting for God's (verse 13).
The verb (makhakh) is to sink or become low; their sin brought them down.

source.text: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he looked on the distress of them, when he heard their cry.

en.L: Yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looked on their distress when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard their cry.
en.B: Even so, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the trouble they were in when their cry reached {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} heard them crying out for help, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw how much they were suffering.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a regardé leur détresse, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a entendu leur cri.
fr.B: Malgré tout, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu dans quelle détresse ils étaient quand leur cri est monté jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Mais quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a entendus crier au secours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu combien ils souffraient.

sw.L: Lakini aliitazama dhiki yao aliposikia kilio chao.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, aliiona taabu waliyokuwa nayo kilio chao kilipomfikia.
sw.R: Lakini aliposikia wakimlilia kwa msaada, aliona jinsi walivyokuwa wakiteseka.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} miró su angustia cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} oyó su clamor.
es.B: Aun así, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vio la aflicción en que estaban cuando su clamor {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llegó.
es.R: Pero cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los oyó clamar pidiendo ayuda, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vio cuánto sufrían.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhìn đến cảnh khốn cùng của họ khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng kêu của họ.
vi.B: Dầu vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thấy cảnh khốn khổ của họ khi tiếng kêu của họ thấu đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe họ kêu cứu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy họ đau khổ biết bao.

decisions.reason: In Judges the LORD was moved by the groaning of his people (Judges 2:18; 10:16), as he had heard their cry in Egypt (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7).

decisions.choice: cry: a loud cry, here a plea
decisions.reason: The word (rinnah) is usually a ringing shout of joy (105:43); here it is a loud cry for help (17:1; 61:2).
The simple "and" joins God's mercy to Israel's rebellion; the sense is "yet", as in verse 8.

source.text: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חֲסָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he remembered for them his covenant, and he relented according to the abundance of his loyal loves.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remembered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant for them, and relented according to the abundance of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love.
en.B: For their sake {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called to mind {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant and turned from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger, because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love is so great.
en.R: He remembered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant with them. Because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is so great, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} decided not to punish them as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had planned.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est souvenu pour eux de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est ravisé selon l’abondance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Pour eux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est rappelé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est revenu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est immense.
fr.R: Il s’est souvenu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance avec eux. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est si grand, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a décidé de ne pas les punir comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait prévu.

sw.L: Naye akalikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa ajili yao, akaghairi kwa kadiri ya wingi wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Kwa ajili yao alilikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, akaiacha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu mno.
sw.R: Alilikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} pamoja nao. Kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu mno, aliamua kutowaadhibu kama alivyokuwa amepanga.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto por ellos, y se arrepintió conforme a la abundancia de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal.
es.B: Por amor a ellos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} trajo a la memoria {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto y se apartó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es muy grande.
es.R: Se acordó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto con ellos. Como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es tan grande, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} decidió no castigarlos como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había pensado.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhớ lại giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì cớ họ, và đổi ý theo sự dư dật của tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì cớ họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nguôi cơn giận, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.
vi.R: Ngài nhớ lại giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với họ. Vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quá lớn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quyết định không phạt họ như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew text notes a difference here between what is written and what is to be read; the words follow the form to be read, "his loyal loves" (plural).

decisions.choice: relented: turned from the judgment he had announced
decisions.reason: The verb (nicham) is used when God turns from a judgment he had threatened (Exodus 32:14). It does not mean that God is fickle; his loyal love moves him to mercy.
The law promised that when the people were in their enemies' land God would remember his covenant (Leviticus 26:42, 45). The words recall 105:8 and 42.
The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: decided not to punish them as he had planned
decisions.reason: Readable says what relenting means here (m2).

The Hebrew niḥam here means that God turned from the punishment he had announced. Literal says "se arrepintió", as Spanish Bibles long have, in the sense of relenting, not of regretting a sin; Balanced says he turned from his anger, and Readable that he decided not to punish.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gave them to compassion before all their captors.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made them [objects of] compassion before all their captors.
en.B: He moved all those who had carried them off to treat them with pity.
en.R: He made the people who had taken them away as prisoners feel sorry for them.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en a fait [des objets de] compassion devant tous ceux qui les avaient emmenés captifs.
fr.B: Il a amené tous ceux qui les avaient déportés à les traiter avec pitié.
fr.R: Il a fait que ceux qui les avaient emmenés comme prisonniers ont eu pitié d’eux.

sw.L: Naye akawafanya kuwa [watu wa] kuhurumiwa mbele ya wote waliowateka.
sw.B: Aliwafanya wote waliokuwa wamewachukua mateka wawahurumie.
sw.R: Aliwafanya watu waliowachukua kama wafungwa wawaonee huruma.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los hizo [objeto de] compasión delante de todos sus captores.
es.B: Movió a todos los que se los habían llevado a tratarlos con piedad.
es.R: Hizo que las personas que se los habían llevado presos sintieran lástima de ellos.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho họ [được] thương xót trước mặt tất cả những kẻ bắt họ làm phu tù.
vi.B: Ngài khiến tất cả những kẻ đã bắt họ đi lưu đày động lòng thương xót họ.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho những người đã bắt họ đi làm tù binh cảm thấy thương họ.

decisions.reason: Solomon prayed that God would grant his exiled people compassion before their captors (1 Kings 8:50). God did so in the days of Ezra and Nehemiah (Ezra 9:9; Nehemiah 1:11).

decisions.choice: gave them to compassion: caused others to pity them
decisions.reason: To "give someone to compassion before" others is to make those others show them mercy.

source.text: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ׀יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Save us, YHWH our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to [the] name of your holiness, to boast in your praise.

en.L: Save us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy name, to glory in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise.
en.B: Rescue us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, and bring us back together from among the nations, so that we may thank {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy name and make our boast in praising {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Save us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God! Bring us back home from the other nations. Then we will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the holy God, and proudly sing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise.

fr.L: Sauve-nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, et rassemble-nous d’entre les nations, pour rendre grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint nom, pour nous glorifier de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.
fr.B: Délivre-nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, et rassemble-nous du milieu des nations, pour que nous rendions grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint nom et que nous mettions notre fierté à {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louer.
fr.R: Sauve-nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ! Ramène-nous chez nous, loin des autres nations. Alors nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierons, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, le Dieu saint, et nous chanterons fièrement {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange.

sw.L: Utuokoe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, utukusanye kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu, tujisifu katika sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Utuokoe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, utukusanye tena kutoka katikati ya mataifa, ili tulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu na kuona fahari katika kukusifu.
sw.R: Utuokoe, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu! Uturudishe nyumbani kutoka kwa mataifa mengine. Ndipo tutakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu mtakatifu, na kuimba sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa fahari.

es.L: Sálvanos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, y reúnenos de entre las naciones, para dar gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo nombre, para gloriarnos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza.
es.B: Rescátanos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios nuestro, y vuelve a juntarnos de entre las naciones, para que demos gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo nombre y nos gloriemos al alabarte.
es.R: ¡Sálvanos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios nuestro! Tráenos de vuelta a casa desde las otras naciones. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daremos gracias a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, el Dios santo, y cantaremos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza con orgullo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng con, xin cứu chúng con, và xin nhóm chúng con lại từ giữa các dân tộc, để cảm tạ danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tự hào trong sự ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng con, xin giải cứu chúng con và nhóm chúng con lại từ giữa các dân tộc, để chúng con cảm tạ danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và lấy việc ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm tự hào.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng con, xin cứu chúng con! Xin đem chúng con từ các dân tộc khác trở về quê hương. Bấy giờ chúng con sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời thánh khiết, và hãnh diện hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: Verses 47-48 close the song in 1 Chronicles 16 (16:35-36), which begins "Say, save us, God of our salvation" and adds "deliver us".

decisions.choice: gather us from the nations: a prayer from exile
decisions.reason: The prayer is spoken by a people still scattered (verse 27). The law promised that if they returned to the LORD he would gather them from all the peoples (Deuteronomy 30:3-4).
The verb (hishtabbeach) is to boast or take pride; their boast will be in praising God.

source.text: בָּר֤וּךְ־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם׀וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] YHWH, [the] God of Israel, from the everlasting and until the everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise Yah.

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen." Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, be blessed from ages past to ages to come! And let all the people answer, "Amen!" Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel! He has always been worthy of praise, and always will be. Let everyone say, "Amen!" Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, d’éternité en éternité ! Et que tout le peuple dise : « Amen. » Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, soit béni depuis les siècles passés jusqu’aux siècles à venir ! Et que tout le peuple réponde : « Amen ! » Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël ! Il a toujours mérité nos louanges, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les méritera toujours. Que tout le monde dise : « Amen ! » Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele hata milele! Na watu wote waseme, "Amina." Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, abarikiwe tangu zamani za kale hata zama zijazo! Watu wote na waitikie, "Amina!" Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli! Amestahili sifa siku zote, na atastahili daima. Kila mtu na aseme, "Amina!" Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: ¡Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, desde la eternidad hasta la eternidad! Y diga todo el pueblo: «Amén». {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}.
es.B: ¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, sea bendito desde los siglos pasados hasta los siglos venideros! Y que todo el pueblo responda: «¡Amén!». ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: ¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel! Siempre ha sido digno de alabanza, y siempre lo será. Que todos digan: «¡Amén!». ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ đời đời cho đến đời đời! Và nguyện cả dân chúng nói: "A-men." Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}.
vi.B: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, được chúc tụng từ muôn đời trước đến muôn đời sau! Và nguyện cả dân chúng đáp: "A-men!" Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên! Ngài luôn luôn đáng được ca ngợi từ xưa đến mãi mãi. Mọi người hãy nói: "A-men!" Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

decisions.reason: This blessing ends Book Four of the Psalms (Psalms 90-106), as 41:14, 72:18-19 and 89:53 end the first three books. Book Five opens with Psalm 107. The blessing closes the whole book as well as this psalm.
The song in 1 Chronicles 16 ends with this blessing, and adds that all the people said "Amen" and praised the LORD (16:36).
Amen ('amen) is a word of agreement: "it is true, so be it". The people make the blessing their own.

decisions.choice: from everlasting to everlasting: for all time, past and future
decisions.reason: The word ('olam) is the farthest time, before or ahead; the pair means always (41:14; 90:2).

The cry "Hallelu-yah" is a command to a group, "praise", with Yah, the short form of the divine name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2). It is rendered "Praise the LORD", with Yah as the alternative for the name.

decisions.choice: "Chúc tụng CHÚA" (L); "Nguyện CHÚA được chúc tụng" (B); "Hãy ca ngợi CHÚA" (R), as Psalm 28:6
decisions.reason: barak is "chúc tụng" at Literal and Balanced, as the terms note sets; Readable says "ca ngợi" (praise), as the English Readable does. "A-men" keeps the form Bible readers know. |
